name: Apple Bandai Pippin
significance: A fascinating failure of the multimedia appliance era, representing Apple's sole entry into the dedicated home video game console market.

editorialContent.overview: Apple's open multimedia computer-console platform manufactured by Bandai, running a stripped-down version of classic Mac OS.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: A fascinating failure of the multimedia appliance era, representing Apple's sole entry into the dedicated home video game console market.
